The department name “English and Creative Writing” is an accurate representation of who we are and what we do. We have long offered undergraduate and graduate courses in both Literature and Creative Writing, but in 2020, we began offering a two-tracked major for anyone majoring in English: the Literature Track and the Creative Writing Track. We also offer a Creative Writing minor, as well as a Creative Writing option for the Masters portfolio and the PhD dissertation. We also wish to disambiguate Creative Writing from other kinds of writing specializations offered by the Department of Professional Writing. We have long offered undergraduate and graduate courses in both Literature and Creative Writing, but in 2020, we began offering a two-tracked major for anyone majoring in English: the Literature Track and the Creative Writing Track. We also offer a Creative Writing minor, as well as a Creative Writing option for the Masters portfolio and the PhD dissertation. We also wish to disambiguate Creative Writing from other kinds of writing specializations offered by the Department of Professional Writing. As matters stand currently, students arriving at URI are often confused. 3. List all programs/courses/departments/schools, etc. that this change affects. English major and minor (undergraduate), A&S; English MA and PhD, Graduate School 4. Include any necessary letters of support.
